concept: Taking ownership of your own path, even when circumstances weren't fully chosen by you
source_inspiration: original content, informed by founder-mindset ownership tradition — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student navigates a realistic situation shaped partly by circumstances outside their control, with real room to influence the outcome despite that
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides how much to focus on what they can't control versus what they can
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what was actually within their power, even in a constrained situation

assessment.success_marker: student identifies genuine agency within real constraints, without denying the constraints exist
